opening.argument: The video presents an ordinary Lowe's retail promotion: a $100 gift-card pack includes a free $10 gift card. The offer is framed as a practical way to purchase products, with the speaker explaining, "So I bought a couple because I got projects always going on" and directing viewers, "if you're in the market, go buy some gift cards." Those statements describe routine store-related purchasing rather than an unusual promise or outcome. The requests to like, subscribe, and enable notifications are separate audience-engagement requests, not conditions for receiving the gift-card offer.
